title: Blind Discovery: Chicane Obstacle Traversal
goal_description: Discover control parameters enabling smooth traversal through chicane obstacles without timeout or collision.

hypotheses.title: Increase Tangential Gain
hypotheses.statement: Increasing the tangential gain will help the robot navigate the tight turns of the chicane obstacles more effectively.
hypotheses.mechanism: The tangential gain affects the robot's ability to maintain a straight path while turning, which is crucial for navigating tight corners.

hypotheses.title: Decrease Safety Margin
hypotheses.statement: Reducing the safety margin will allow the robot to get closer to the obstacles, potentially enabling tighter turns and smoother traversal.
hypotheses.mechanism: A smaller safety margin means the robot can approach the obstacles more closely, which can be beneficial for navigating tight spaces.

hypotheses.title: Increase Repulsion Gain
hypotheses.statement: Boosting the repulsion gain will enhance the robot's ability to avoid obstacles, which is critical for navigating the tight turns of the chicane.
hypotheses.mechanism: A higher repulsion gain will make the robot more responsive to obstacles, allowing it to maintain a safe distance and navigate the turns more smoothly.

action_log.message: Formulated 3 competing testable hypotheses grounded in physical dynamics.
